digest.component_or_area: mutation testing gate and CI workflow
propositions: Mutation test shard enforcement must transition from stale whole-file counts (491 mutants) to evidence-based phased promotion, starting all shards as advisory and promoting only after proven runtime and stability thresholds.

Shards operate in three explicit modes—advisory (head-only, nonblocking survivors), ratchet (base/head comparison, blocks regressions on unchanged functions), and strict (requires killed mutants or reviewed equivalent fingerprints)—each defined in a canonical manifest with no duplicate repository configuration.

Fresh isolated base/head archives with no cached mutation verdicts, pinned mutmut 3.7.0, timeout_constant=1.0, timeout_multiplier=15.0, and per-shard 30-minute job caps must prevent false regressions and guarantee deterministic evidence.

Selector must map changed source, test, and support files to exact shards, preserve renames and deletions, report unmatched tests, fail on unresolved refs, emit JSON for targeted or all-shard runs, and skip explicitly on empty selection.
Documentation must define phased modes, promotion evidence requirements, manifest authority, per-shard evidence cadence, and false-positive policy while removing stale score and budget tables.
